normalization: Exactly the earlier secondary units: input SD sqrt(3/32), relative R/W/b parameter-block RMS, unchanged tanh state, fixed-head q=ones/sqrt(n), beta=max(1,Frobenius R), future preactivations [1/4,3/4]^n.
additional_prefix: Archived normalized count at sigma>=1e-3, clipped to16; no new-witness selection.
primary_projection: Dyadic approximations to normalized SVD left axes; history directions are dyadic normal basis plus dyadic N V. Certify an exact fixed-h curved chart and a Cartesian product in those sensitivity projections, not a flat full-S box.
secondary_projection: Only after primary is frozen: query-frame dual projection, using the SAME SVD history axes. Finite-head Gram dual chooses output functionals; re-certify and map margins back to the same physical error metric.
finite_head_queries: Gamma columns (1/4)I+(5/8)11^T, i.e. one gate7/8, others5/8; certified contained in accepted gate interval. No query scaling beyond frozen beta.
curvature: Uniform componentwise directional/mixed derivative majorants over the actual history box, including implicit fixed-h corrections. CPU binary64 operations use nextafter outward rounding; dyadic interval/exact rational checks verify center derivatives and contraction inequalities.
weak_direction_diagnostics: Reduced-square isotropic certificate arithmetic on retained D,D-1,ceil(.95D),ceil(.9D), top1/4/8/16, using an unchanged global Hessian majorant. Diagnostic application of the accepted radius method, not a reproof.
gpu_policy: CPU is primary: n<=4, all certificates require dyadic/rational/high-precision work, and current Torch build is CPU-only. GPU numerical exploration would add transfers/dependencies without material benefit for these sizes; no GPU workload is planned.
classification: Large: dense jointly robust count>=half its available dimension at all widths. Partial: some dense product has>=4 robust directions. Few: any certified nonzero packing below those levels. Zero: all six have valid jointly certified regions but no nontrivial primary packing after declared secondary attempt. Too loose: missing reliable certificates/controls prevent those statements. These are descriptive labels, not discovery thresholds.
stop: Stop after certificate/report. No new width, architecture, training, GAS-0, Stage C or AMS v10.
